verdict.rationale: IVS documents a public API surface: a data-plane API 'described in detail' for multitrack video broadcast clients, chat APIs for interactive apps, and AWS CLI usage, which together suggest it can be driven programmatically. The evidence does not show a full control-plane API reference for creating and managing channels, stages and recordings, and the OpenAPI probe found no spec. Missing for 10: explicit control-plane API reference covering resource management, machine-readable API spec, hands-on corroboration of end-to-end programmatic control.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API

citations.quote: Describes in detail the IVS data-plane API for broadcast-software developers implementing client support for multitrack video.
Integrate into interactive apps with chat APIs, and Player and Broadcast SDKs for mobile and web.
